response.sql: WITH event_rates AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CASE WHEN b.spent <> 0 AND b.amount <> 0 THEN 1.0 * b.spent / b.amount END) AS event_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type) SELECT type, average_spending_rate, average_spending_rate / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_spending_rate) FROM type_rates), 0) AS relative_spending_rate FROM type_rates;

assumptions.assumption: A line with amount 0 has an undefined spending rate, so it is ignored in the averages. An event type with no defined rate is returned with NULL rates.
